description: This file implements a broadcaster for Kubernetes watch events, managing multiple watchers, event distribution, and channel behavior.

classes.name: Broadcaster
classes.description: Distributes events to multiple watchers, managing event queues and watcher states.

classes.name: broadcasterWatcher
classes.description: Represents a single watcher of the Broadcaster, handling result channel and stop logic.

methods.name: NewBroadcaster
methods.description: Creates a new Broadcaster with specified queue length and channel behavior.

methods.name: NewLongQueueBroadcaster
methods.description: Creates a Broadcaster with incoming queue size equal to outgoing queues.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Adds a new watcher, returning an interface for event reception.

methods.name: WatchWithPrefix
methods.description: Adds a watcher with initial queued events, ensuring it receives past events.

methods.name: Action
methods.description: Distributes an event to all watchers, blocking until queued.

methods.name: ActionOrDrop
methods.description: Attempts to distribute an event; drops if queues are full.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Stops all watchers and closes channels, ensuring all events are distributed.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main goroutine receiving events and distributing them to watchers.

methods.name: distribute
methods.description: Sends an event to all watchers, respecting channel behavior.

methods.name: stopWatching
methods.description: Removes a watcher by ID and closes its result channel.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.description: Closes all watcher channels and clears the watcher map.

methods.name: blockQueue
methods.description: Executes a function with the incoming queue locked, ensuring event order.
